stem: A media company runs large aggregations across billions of event rows and needs a cost-effective store optimized for analytical scans across selected columns.

choices.text: Use Amazon RDS for OLTP and treat it as the default petabyte analytics warehouse.
Use Amazon API Gateway caching as the historical columnar data warehouse.
Use AWS Step Functions execution history as the long-term SQL analytics store.
Use Amazon Redshift with columnar storage for analytical workloads.

rationale: Redshift columnar storage is optimized for analytical scan patterns and reduced disk I/O. RDS OLTP engines can run analytics but are not the default fit for this warehouse requirement. API Gateway caching and Step Functions history are not data warehouse platforms.
